fib: ______ is a Hellenistic gospel written for the Greeks.
Mark is a Hellenistic gospel written for the Greeks.
______ is the sole bearer of the Spirit.
After his baptism Jesus is the sole bearer of the Spirit.
______ is a collection of various sayings of Jesus without any connecting narrative.
Thomas is a collection of various sayings of Jesus without any connecting narrative.
______ are the first three Gospels in the New Testament: The Gospel of Matthew, the Gospel of Mark and the Gospel of Luke.
The synoptic Gospels are the first three Gospels in the New Testament: The Gospel of Matthew, the Gospel of Mark and the Gospel of Luke.
______ is the only Gospel in the Bible to make explicit use of the term "church" (Matt. 16:18; 18:17).
The Gospel of Matthew is the only Gospel in the Bible to make explicit use of the term "church" (Matt. 16:18; 18:17).
